description: Use when the user wants to know which B2B SaaS markets/categories IndustryLens tracks, or needs a slug for get_market_landscape. Returns the list of markets, ordered by name. Each item has a `slug` usable with get_market_landscape for the full category map. On an authenticated account, the caller's OWN market is always included (flagged `is_your_market: true`) even when it isn't one of the small public showcase markets.
name: list_markets
title: List the markets IndustryLens tracks
